title: Read the challenge before writing anything
body: Challenge product-arena-04-4b82ad21 is 写作08｜引言与相关工作写作. It is a Skill-authoring task, not a paper reproduction: the platform installs the Skill at /skills/weekly-skill and runs official DeepSeek Harness on three fixed cases, with and without the Skill. The four graded questions are 立得住 / 分得清 / 说得实 / 对得上. Budget: 64 model requests, 900 s, 16384 tokens per response; skill resources at most 50 UTF-8 text files, 500 KB each, 2 MB total. These steps record the authoring and self-verification run of this bundle; the platform records the native session trace separately and that one is authoritative.

title: Grade on what can be checked, not on what reads well
body: A base agent asked to write an introduction produces fluent prose with decorative citations. The failure modes the rubric names are all checkable: citations that do not exist, claims with no source, related work that is a paper-by-paper summary, gaps asserted rather than derived, contributions that point at nothing. So the design is: four ledgers written before the prose, then 18 deterministic checks run after it. The model does the judgement, the script does the verification, and the two never substitute for each other.

title: Dedupe and reference-list linking work on the first run
body: The arXiv and published copies of MolCLR merged on an exact title match, and all 10 manuscript reference-list entries linked to library records by title overlap 1.00. So numeric citations can be resolved to specific reference ids, which is what makes the bibliography numbering checkable.

title: Seven warnings on a correct draft are seven bugs
body: Bare comparative connectives (however, 相比之下) fired as unsourced claims; BibTeX en-dash page ranges failed the page-format check; 'this paper treats' was not recognised as an own-work link; and three paragraphs of one-citation-per-sentence were called a serial summary. A false positive costs reviewer trust, so each was tightened rather than shipped.

title: Tighten the triggers instead of lowering the bar
body: R02 now fires only on the three high-precision signals (a unit-bearing or decimal number, a literature-attribution phrase, a superlative); comparative connectives were removed entirely. R08 only calls a serial summary when the paragraph contains no comparative vocabulary at all. R04 normalises en dashes and accepts article numbers such as bbae051. R11 accepts 'this paper / we treat' as the own-work link.

title: The self-test caught my own bibliography bug
body: refs_cited.txt started with Gilmer as [1] while the draft's [1] was Kipf: the list was rendered in discovery order instead of the draft's citation order. Every numeric manuscript would have shipped a mis-numbered bibliography. Fixed by carrying the draft's own citation numbers through resolution into result.result.reference_numbering and rendering from them; the self-test now asserts the two agree.

title: Skill entry point
body: Six-step workflow, four-part contract, 18-rule table, failure handling, self-check list.

title: Self-test summary
body: 28/28 assertions across four scenarios; 21/21 planted defects caught; 1.76 s wall time.

title: Characterization
body: Ten self-test targets, seven envelope dimensions, ten failure modes, five sensitivity notes. Marked explicitly as local fixtures, not official case results.

title: Final state
body: 28/28 self-test checks passed, 21/21 planted defects caught. Clean fixture gate=pass with 0 errors and 0 warnings; Chinese fixture gate=pass with GB/T 7714 output; no-library fixture degrades to partial and says so in limits. Known blind spots are documented rather than papered over: no literature search, integer-only fabrication not caught, paraphrase evidence not auto-checked.

title: What I would do next with more budget
body: Two extensions the checks make cheap: (1) an evaluation-gap rule that compares the metric sets of grouped works and flags a group whose works are not comparable because they report different metrics; (2) a contribution-to-gap cross-check that requires every contribution to fill at least one gap, catching contributions that exist in the list but are not motivated by the stated gap.
